import warnings
import numpy as np
import scipy.special as sp
import statsmodels.api as sm

n = 50
z = np.linspace(-1e4, 1e4, n)
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), z])
y = np.ones(n, dtype=int)
params = np.array([0.0, 1.0])
model = sm.Logit(y, X)

with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as wlist:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    llobs = np.asarray(model.loglikeobs(params), dtype=float)
    ll = float(model.loglike(params))

msgs = [str(w.message) for w in wlist if issubclass(w.category, RuntimeWarning)]
n_over = sum(1 for m in msgs if "overflow" in m)

ref = sp.log_expit(z)
with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
    finite = np.isfinite(llobs)
    all_finite_obs = float(bool(np.all(finite)))
    n_nonfinite_obs = float(np.sum(~finite))
    all_finite_ll = float(bool(np.isfinite(ll)))
    diff = np.abs(llobs - ref)
    max_diff = float(np.max(diff))
    ref_sum = float(np.sum(ref))

probe("all_finite_loglikeobs", all_finite_obs)
probe("n_nonfinite_loglikeobs", n_nonfinite_obs)
probe("all_finite_loglike", all_finite_ll)
probe("runtime_warning_count", float(len(msgs)))
probe("overflow_warning_count", float(n_over))
probe("loglike_minus_ref_sum", ll - ref_sum)
probe("max_abs_diff_vs_log_expit", max_diff)
